name: Rustic Timbers Furniture Co.
old_description: Rustic Timbers Furniture Co. specializes in rugged, hand-crafted furniture for your home, lodge, or cabin. Our products are made in America and are designed to last a lifetime. We offer decor for virtually every room in your home or business.
about:
Rustic Timbers Furniture Co. operates from Branson West, Missouri, along Highway 76 in the Ozarks region. The company describes itself as an "Ozarks Original," though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company produces rugged, hand-crafted furniture and home decor items, including bedroom and living room pieces, taxidermy mounts, wall decor, and chandeliers. All products are described as hand-crafted in the United States, made in America, and designed to last a lifetime. The firm offers decor for virtually every room in a home or business. Specific production capacity, facility size, and employee count are not disclosed.

Rustic Timbers serves residential customers furnishing homes, lodges, and cabins, as well as commercial clients such as hospitality businesses. The company's showroom on Highway 76 caters to walk-in traffic and interior decor inquiries, supported by a knowledgeable staff ready to answer design questions.

The company emphasizes its American-made, hand-crafted approach as a differentiator, positioning its pieces as one-of-a-kind works of art designed for longevity, with each item built to last.
type_evidence: All of our furniture is hand-crafted right here in the USA and is built to last.
